2026 SRW Discout Schedule (07/2026)

#2 Soft Red Winter Wheat

Discount Rates:
              Test Weight:           57.9 - 57.5          10 cents/bu
                                     57.4 - 56.5          5 cents/bu each 1/2 lb
                                     56.4 and below       10 cents/bu each 1/2 lb
                                     Subject to rejection below 53 lbs

              Moisture:              13.51%-14.0%       4 cent/bu and .375% shrink each 1/4%
                                     14.1% and above    6 cents/bu .375% shrink each 1/4%
                                     14.5% and above subject to rejection

              Dockage:               2 cents each 1/10% above 0.8%
                                     Dockage will be deducted from gross
                                     weight, plus monetary discounts

              Damage Kernels Total   1.1% to 2.0%       2 cents/bu each %
                                     2.1% to 6.0%       3 cents/bu each %
                                     6.1% to 10.0%      4 cents/bu each %
                                     10% and above subject to rejection

              In Charge:             8 cents per bushel

              Out Charge:            8 cents per bushel

              Musty:                 10 cents (Subject to Rejection)
              Sour:                  10 cents (Subject to Rejection)
              COFO:                  20 cents (Subject to Rejection)
              Infested:              10 cents (Subject to Rejection)
              Vomitoxin:             30 cents per point starting at 2.01 PPM (Subject to Rejection)

              Storage:               Unavailable. All grain will be spotted upon acceptance.
